lines.x: President Javier Milei's administration seeks to submit a trade agreement with the US to Congress before year-end, while Washington reviews supply chain product traceability and steel tariff concerns.
Tesla will formally open its first showroom in Argentina on November 20 at the Unicenter commercial center in Martínez, launching direct retail operations.

President Javier Milei detailed plans for his second-term agenda in Argentina, focusing on tax reductions, returning funds to taxpayers, boosting mineral and agricultural exports, and deepening economic deregulation.
Argentine investment platform Cocos closed an investment round backed by venture firm Kaszek, reaching a $500 million valuation.
